name: Harudera Yuria
source:
[url=/c567]Yuuji's[/url] guardian and work boss. Her former name is Julia Bardera but she changed it after moving to Japan, that’s why Yuuji calls her JB. Though she looks American, she is half-German and half-Italian. She also drives a yellow Ferrari.

[From [url=http://vnsharing.net/forum/showthread.php?t=302644/]Shiori-chan's review[/url]]
